Top covers on all 7 cells (cover:...;full;top for each base)

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: capOpenFaces added 18 solid end caps covering all open perimeter faces; check_build reports no OPEN_CAP_FACE issues, meshClash clear

finish.summary: Built a seven-cell honeycomb (one centre cell plus six ring cells) of full bases at level 0, with top covers on all seven cells forming a continuous work surface. Ran capOpenFaces (18 solid end caps on every open outside edge) and lockJoints (12 joint bolts). Layout confirmed from above; check_build passes with meshClash clear and a single connected group.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Seven-cell honeycomb desk, top-covered with all outer edges capped — first mapping the current build and where bases and covers fit.
